speaker: spouse
text: Your spouse is waiting in the residence, phone still open on a news alert. "The camera crews have found the school," they say. "Our child can't walk to class without a lens in their face. Send us to the private estate for the rest of the term, or we stay here and project strength - but I won't forgive either one easily."

choices.text: Send them away for their safety.
Keep them in the residence. We must project strength.
